name: Sanad Card
summary: The Sanad Card confirms your registered support needs so typing centres, clinics and government service counters can adjust how they serve you without asking you to re-explain each time.
whoQualifies: UAE nationals and residents with a registered determination (disability) assessment
Guardians applying on behalf of a person of determination they represent
documentsRequired: Determination (disability) assessment letter from an approved medical centre
Guardian's Emirates ID and proof of guardianship, if applying on someone's behalf
processingTime: 5 to 7 working days from a complete application (placeholder)
howToApply: Book an appointment at a Sanad typing centre or apply online
Bring the required documents to your appointment
Complete the biometric capture if requested
Collect the card or have it delivered to your registered address
exampleQuestions: What documents do I need for a Sanad Card?
